jobs.occupation: Project Executive (f/m/d) - Healthcare,Berlin,Frankfurt,München,Hamburg,Nürnberg (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Project Executive (f/m/d) for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Your role You support the planning, coordination, and delivery of healthcare market research and innovation projects from proposal stage through to execution. You work closely with project managers, insights teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards. You coordinate external suppliers and partners, tracking project progress and supporting the management of timelines, deliverables, and documentation. You maintain project documentation and ensure that project records, specifications, and study materials are complete, accurate, and up to date. You support data management activities, including data validation, quality control, and preparation of deliverables using tools such as Excel and other reporting platforms. You contribute to testing activities for surveys, research platforms, and project workflows, helping to identify issues and support process improvements and automation efforts. You assist in monitoring project risks, resolving operational challenges, and ensuring smooth collaboration across internal and external teams. You act as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, providing regular status updates and ensuring transparency throughout the project lifecycle. You contribute to the continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and ways of working, including the use of AI and automation solutions. You collaborate with colleagues across Ipsos Germany and the international Healthcare network to support successful project delivery. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have initial professional experience in project management, market research, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, or a related field through internships, working student positions, or early-career employment. You have a strong interest in project coordination, operational excellence, and delivering high-quality client work. You possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to managing multiple tasks and deadlines. You are comfortable working with data and have advanced Excel skills; experience with SPSS, Power BI, or Python skills are a plus. You have an interest in data management, process optimization, testing, and automation. You demonstrate strong communication and stakeholder management skills and enjoy collaborating with suppliers, clients, and cross-functional teams. You are fluent in English; German language skills are a plus. You are proactive, team-oriented, and motivated to learn and grow in an international healthcare research environment. Experience working with AI-based solutions, survey platforms, reporting tools, or research technologies is a plus. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide! You can look forward to: Hybrid work Flexible working hours Workation in European countries Ipsos Corporate Benefits Subsidy for the Germany public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket) Job rotation opportunities Development & learning culture International collaboration Events & local community Diversity & inclusion initiatives Corporate social responsibility programs Modern workplace Interested? Standort: Berlin
Startdatum: 01.03.2026
Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026
Stellennummer: MER0003ZHR
Arbeitszeit: Full time

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. jobs.occupation: Working student - AI & Semantic Data Integration for Digital Transformation Architecture (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the digital architecture team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working student - AI & Semantic Data Integration for Digital Transformation Architecture (d/f/m)

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know work of a digital architect focusing on the frontier of AI? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the digital architecture team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ottobrunn in the Munich area
- Start: November 2026
- Duration: 12 -24 months

The mission of the architecture unit is to plan and design state of the art, sustainable and secured enterprise digital solutions for our customers, partners and everybody and you can be part of this exciting journey. The transformation programs architecture team, which you will become part of, has the particular mission to define the future to-be target architecture for a full digital continuity of all key value streams of the company. This includes the design of the major enterprise platforms like ALM, PLM, ERP, CRM, MOM/MES but also technology watch and application of emerging technologies. You will specifically focus on the intersection of AI and Data: exploring Agentic Coding, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and building a unified Semantic Layer (using Neo4j) to enable seamless data integration between architect management tools like Aris, Alfabet, and the Data Catalog.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Travelling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Contribute to the research and exploration of Agentic AI workflows and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enterprise use cases.
- Contribute to the development of a Semantic Layer using Graph Databases (Neo4j) to integrate data across Aris, Alfabet, and the Data Catalog.
- Contribute to the design of automated data pipelines and semantic mappings between disparate enterprise architecture tools.
- Contribute to the deployment and orchestration of AI-driven services and integration layers within OpenShift environments.
- Contribute to the modeling of the digital architecture on different layers (business, functional, data, technical) to support the semantic integration.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of computer science, data science, engineering, or an equivalent field of study.
- First practical experience in Python programming or working with Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j) is highly desirable.
- Interest in cutting-edge AI developments, specifically LLM Agents, RAG, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud-native environments like OpenShift is a plus.
- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and data integration patterns is desirable.
- Fluent in German and English.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrolment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and applyonline (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
